settings.introZh: 这里记录我长期体验过的游戏、游玩时长、完成情况与部分设计观察。Steam 记录首次导入后会保存为本地数据；主机、手游和其他平台游戏可以手动补充。
settings.introEn: A record of games I have spent meaningful time with, including playtime, completion status, achievements, and selected design observations. Steam records are stored as a local snapshot after import, while non-Steam titles can be added manually.
settings.steamNoteZh: Steam 主页用于核对公开的游戏库与游玩时长；本页也包含非 Steam 游戏，因此两边不会完全一致。
settings.steamNoteEn: My public Steam profile can be used to verify library and playtime data. This page also includes non-Steam titles, so the two lists are not expected to match exactly.
